accounts.name: sponsor
docs: Must be validator #1 (the first validator in the registry).

accounts.name: admin_signer
docs: Admin signer — required in bootstrap mode, ignored in peer-consensus
(the endorsement account carries authority instead).

accounts.name: authority
docs: Court authority or designated adjudicator — must be registry admin.

instructions.name: attach_parcel
docs: Attach a parcel to an identity (the person behind its owner wallet).
Only the parcel's owner may do this, and only for an identity whose
owner wallet matches.

instructions.name: attest
docs: Register an attestation that binds heavy off-chain data to this parcel
and records the set of validator wallets required to validate it.
**DEPRECATED**: Use `create_claim` in the verification pipeline instead.
This instruction remains for backward compatibility with existing
attestations. New attestations should use `Claim → Evidence → Observation`.
`validators` holds the public keys of the (possibly several) parties
who must sign off on the transaction; `required` is how many signatures
are needed. The signer must be the parcel owner or a registered
registrar. Per-validator Ed25519 signatures live off-chain but are
verified against this on-chain identity set and `content_hash`.

accounts.name: session_tracker
docs: Must match the tracker for this claim.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Must be the original triggerer or registry admin.

instructions.name: grant_identity_right
docs: Grant an identity-based right on a parcel. Only the parcel owner (or
current granter) may sign. The `identity` must be a valid Identity PDA
owned by the signer.
Authorization: the granter must be either the legacy `parcel.owner` wallet
**or** the holder of an active OWNERSHIP IdentityRights for this parcel.
This enables identity-based ownership to grant sub-rights without
requiring the legacy wallet field.
PDA: `["identity_rights", identity, parcel, rights_kind]`.

instructions.name: grant_right
docs: Grant a right on a parcel to `holder`. Owner-only.
`nonce` must equal the parcel's current `rights_count`, which is
incremented so every right gets a unique PDA.

instructions.name: judicial_forfeiture
docs: Force-transfer a parcel's ownership away from a non-compliant owner, per
a court order. This is deliberately heavier than a normal transfer:
at least `MIN_FORFEIT_VALIDATORS` (2) of the declared validators must
sign this transaction themselves, and the order is bound to a
`case_hash` (e.g. SHA-256 of the court order document) for auditability.
This is how validators collectively inform the chain that land no longer
belongs to someone who refuses to release it — e.g. repossession by a
government, or a court ruling that title passed to another person.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Relaying authority (court clerk / govt channel). Must NOT be the owner.

instructions.name: migrate_attestation_to_claim
docs: Migrate a legacy attestation into a verification pipeline claim.
**DEPRECATED**: This is a one-way bridge for migrating old attestations.
New attestations should use `create_claim` directly.

accounts.name: session_tracker
docs: Singleton guard: enforces single active session per claim.

accounts.name: entity
docs: Must be an account owned by this program so arbitrary keys cannot
pollute the audit log (M-2).

accounts.name: session_tracker
docs: Must match the tracker for this claim (cleared when quorum reached).

accounts.name: signer
docs: The session opener, registry admin, or a registered validator must sign.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The session opener, registry admin, or a registered validator must sign.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The session opener, registry admin, or a registered validator must sign.

instructions.name: register_document
docs: Register an IPFS document anchor tied to an attestation.
**DEPRECATED**: Use `add_evidence` in the verification pipeline instead.

instructions.name: register_parcel
docs: Register a new parcel on-chain. The signer becomes its owner.
`id` is a caller-provided unique 32-byte identifier (e.g. a SHA-256 of
the parcel geometry). It is also the PDA seed, so it can never change.

accounts.name: holder
docs: Holder must sign.

accounts.name: granter
docs: Granter must co-sign (original granter or current parcel owner).

accounts.name: caller
docs: Must be the original triggerer or registry admin.

instructions.name: revoke_identity_right
docs: Revoke an identity-based right. The original granter may revoke.

instructions.name: revoke_right
docs: Revoke a previously granted right. The parcel owner or the original
granter may revoke. The account is closed and its lamports returned.
The parcel's rights counter is decremented so the freed nonce can be
reused by a future grant (safe: the old account no longer exists).

instructions.name: rotate_validators
docs: Replace the validator set on an attestation (the fix for dead/leaving
validators). Only the parcel owner may rotate. Bumps `version` so a
reconstituted set is provably newer, and resets `required`/`count`.
**DEPRECATED**: Use the verification pipeline's validator management instead.

accounts.name: seller
docs: Seller receives SOL.

accounts.name: buyer
docs: Buyer receives excess deposit.

accounts.name: observer
docs: fields on ObservationV2 capture subject/capture_device separation.

instructions.name: transfer_parcel
docs: Transfer ownership of a parcel. Only the current owner can sign.

instructions.name: update_infrastructure
docs: Set the parcel's infrastructure flag bitmask together with the canonical
access digest produced by the off-chain validation engine. Owner-only.
`access_hash` must be non-zero and match the digests the off-chain
engine derives for these flags on the parcel geometry.

instructions.name: update_status
docs: Update a parcel's status (e.g. for-sale). Owner-only.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Treasury PDA receiving slashed lamports. Constrained to a deterministic
PDA derived from the authority registry — no one can redirect funds to
an arbitrary wallet.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Must be a registered validator or registry admin.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Zone authority co-sign: every accepted proof is explicitly attested.
(Circuit-level verification is deferred to audit; see RFC-011.)

types.name: AmalgamationRecord
docs: One record per source parcel being merged into a result parcel.
PDA seed: `["amalgamation", result_parcel, source_parcel]`.

fields.name: result_parcel
docs: The merged result parcel's PDA key.

fields.name: source_parcel
docs: A source parcel being merged in.

fields.name: source_geometry_hash
docs: Source's geometry hash at time of amalgamation.

fields.name: result_geometry_hash
docs: Result's geometry hash.

fields.name: rights_merged
docs: Whether rights from this source have been merged.

fields.name: initiated_by
docs: Wallet that initiated the amalgamation.

fields.name: completed_at
docs: When merge finished (0 if in progress).

fields.name: status
docs: 0=Pending, 1=Completed, 2=Failed.

types.name: Attestation
docs: An on-chain attestation that binds a set of off-chain documents/data to a
parcel and records *who* (which wallets) must validate a transaction.
**DEPRECATED**: This parcel-centric attestation model is superseded by the
verification pipeline (`Claim → Evidence → Observation → VerificationAttestation`).
Existing accounts remain valid for backward compatibility, but new attestations
should use the verification pipeline. A bridge instruction (`migrate_attestation_to_claim`)
is provided to transition legacy attestations into the new model.
PDA: `["attestation", parcel, specifier]`. The heavy payload — actual
documents and per-validator Ed25519 signatures — lives off-chain, but it is
anchored here by `content_hash`, and each validator's public key is recorded
so that any signature can be independently verified against this list.

fields.name: specifier
docs: 32-byte specifier (e.g. sha256 over the artifact/signing-session id).

fields.name: content_hash
docs: sha-256 over the off-chain payload (documents, deed, survey, ...).

fields.name: required
docs: Required threshold of validator signatures to consider this validated.

fields.name: count
docs: Number of validator keys currently registered (<= MAX_VALIDATORS).

fields.name: version
docs: Monotonic rotation counter. Each rotate_validators bumps it so a
reconstituted validator set is provably newer than the previous one.

fields.name: document_count
docs: Number of IPFS documents anchored to this attestation (capped by
MAX_DOCUMENTS_PER_ATTESTATION in register_document).

types.name: AuditEntry
docs: Append-only audit log of all verification state transitions.
PDA: `["audit_entry", entity, sequence_bytes]`

fields.name: entity
docs: The entity this audit entry is about (claim, session, challenge, etc.).

fields.name: sequence
docs: Monotonic sequence number for this entity.

fields.name: action
docs: Type of transition (see audit_action constants).

fields.name: from_status
docs: Previous status value.

fields.name: to_status
docs: New status value.

fields.name: actor
docs: Who triggered the transition.

fields.name: metadata_hash
docs: Optional metadata hash (sha-256 of additional context).

types.name: Challenge
docs: An on-chain challenge to a verified claim. Anyone may challenge a
verified claim by providing evidence. Validators review and vote.
PDA: `["challenge", claim, challenger]`

fields.name: claim
docs: The claim being challenged.

fields.name: challenger
docs: Who filed the challenge.

fields.name: challenge_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the off-chain challenge document / evidence.

fields.name: status
docs: Current challenge status.

fields.name: uphold_votes
docs: Number of validators who voted to uphold.

fields.name: overturn_votes
docs: Number of validators who voted to overturn.

fields.name: required_votes
docs: Required votes to resolve.

fields.name: voters
docs: Validators who voted (deduplication record).

fields.name: claim_id
docs: Unique claim identifier (caller-provided, e.g. SHA-256 of the statement).

fields.name: parcel
docs: The parcel this claim is about.

fields.name: claim_type
docs: Type of claim (see claim_type constants).

fields.name: submitted_by
docs: Participant who submitted the claim.

fields.name: status
docs: Current status (see claim_status constants).

fields.name: statement_hash
docs: sha-256 hash of the off-chain claim statement / document.

fields.name: version
docs: Monotonic version counter. Incremented on status transitions.

fields.name: evidence_count
docs: Number of evidence items attached to this claim.

fields.name: observation_count
docs: Number of observations submitted for this claim.

fields.name: attestation_count
docs: Number of attestations submitted for this claim.

fields.name: required_attestations
docs: Quorum threshold — number of attestations needed to verify.

types.name: ClaimSessionTracker
docs: Singleton guard PDA that tracks which session is currently active for a
given claim. Prevents opening multiple concurrent verification sessions
for the same claim.
PDA: `["claim_session_tracker", claim_key]`

fields.name: claim
docs: The claim this tracker belongs to.

fields.name: active_session
docs: The currently active session (zero key = no active session).

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for deterministic derivation.

fields.name: country_code
docs: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

fields.name: approved_admin
docs: Admin wallet approved to create this country's ValidatorRegistry.

types.name: CrossBorderVerification
docs: Bridges cross-border identity bindings into the verification pipeline.
PDA: `["cross_border_verification", binding]`

fields.name: binding
docs: The JurisdictionBinding account being verified.

fields.name: claim
docs: Associated Claim (if any).

fields.name: session
docs: Associated VerificationSession (if any).

fields.name: jurisdiction
docs: The Jurisdiction account.

fields.name: status
docs: Current status (0=pending, 1=verified, 2=revoked).

fields.name: verified_by
docs: Who verified this binding.

types.name: Dispute
docs: An on-chain dispute record bound to a parcel.
PDA: `["dispute", parcel, case_hash]`. The `case_hash` is a SHA-256 over
the off-chain court document or complaint, anchoring evidence immutably.

fields.name: parcel
docs: The parcel under dispute.

fields.name: filed_by
docs: The wallet that filed the dispute.

fields.name: case_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the off-chain court document / complaint.

fields.name: status
docs: Current dispute status (FILED → FROZEN → ADJUDICATED → EXECUTED).

fields.name: required
docs: Required validator co-signatures to advance this dispute.

fields.name: declared_count
docs: Number of validators declared at filing time (NOT actual signatures collected).

fields.name: validators
docs: Declared validator set for this dispute.

fields.name: present_validators
docs: Validators that actually co-signed (recorded at freeze/adjudicate).
Unlike `validators` (declared at filing), this is on-chain proof of
who testified — events alone are not reliably indexable.

fields.name: present_count
docs: How many entries of `present_validators` are populated.

fields.name: outcome
docs: Outcome of adjudication (OWNER_WINS or OWNER_LOSES). Set at adjudication.

fields.name: new_owner
docs: New owner if outcome is OWNER_LOSES. Set at adjudication.

fields.name: attestation
docs: The attestation this document belongs to.

fields.name: cid
docs: IPFS CID v1 of the document.

fields.name: content_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the document bytes (integrity check).

fields.name: category
docs: Document category (e.g. "deed", "survey", "photo").

fields.name: registered_by
docs: Who registered this document.

fields.name: registry
docs: The ValidatorRegistry this injection targets.

fields.name: requested_by
docs: Admin who queued the injection.

fields.name: candidate
docs: Validator public key to inject.

fields.name: execute_after
docs: Unix timestamp after which the injection can be executed.

fields.name: executed
docs: True once executed.

types.name: EscrowRecord
docs: An on-chain escrow record for a parcel sale.
PDA seed: `["escrow", parcel_key]`. One escrow per parcel.

fields.name: parcel
docs: The parcel being sold.

fields.name: seller
docs: Wallet of the seller (must match parcel.owner).

fields.name: buyer
docs: Wallet of the buyer (set at creation).

fields.name: amount
docs: Sale price in lamports.

fields.name: deposit_amount
docs: Amount deposited so far by buyer.

fields.name: vault
docs: Vault PDA holding deposited SOL.

fields.name: status
docs: Current escrow status.

fields.name: settle_deadline
docs: accepted_at + SETTLEMENT_WINDOW_SECS

fields.name: cancel_deadline
docs: created_at + CANCEL_WINDOW_SECS

fields.name: dispute_case_hash
docs: Case hash if dispute filed (0 if none).

fields.name: claim
docs: The claim this evidence supports.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Monotonic nonce within the claim (0, 1, 2, ...).

fields.name: submitted_by
docs: Participant who submitted this evidence.

fields.name: evidence_type
docs: Type of evidence (see evidence_type constants).

fields.name: content_hash
docs: sha-256 hash of the off-chain evidence content.

fields.name: storage_reference
docs: Storage reference (IPFS CID, URL, or content address).

fields.name: observed_at
docs: When the evidence was originally observed (off-chain), if applicable.

types.name: GenesisConfirmation
docs: Record of a cross-country genesis confirmation.

fields.name: validator
docs: Validator who confirmed.

fields.name: country_code
docs: Country code of the confirming validator.

fields.name: country_code
docs: The country being genesis'd.

fields.name: requested_by
docs: Admin requesting genesis (must match allocation).

fields.name: confirmations
docs: Confirmations from validators of other countries.

fields.name: finalized
docs: True once quorum and diversity requirements are met.

types.name: GuardianClaim
docs: Bridge between the guardian/court system and the verification pipeline.
When a guardianship event occurs (e.g. court-ordered guardianship via
`terra_identity`), a GuardianClaim can be created to link that event
into the verification pipeline.
PDA: `["guardian_claim", claim]`

fields.name: claim
docs: The associated Claim account.

fields.name: identity
docs: The identity under guardianship.

fields.name: triggered_by
docs: Who triggered the guardianship (court/guardian wallet).

fields.name: case_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the court case document.

fields.name: guardian_type
docs: Guardian type (0=court, 1=council, 2=emergency).

fields.name: status
docs: Current status (0=pending, 1=active, 2=resolved, 3=disputed).

types.name: IdentityRights
docs: An identity-based right that links an Identity PDA to a Parcel.
This is the foundation for replacing raw wallet ownership (`Parcel.owner`)
with identity-centric ownership. Rather than a wallet pubkey holding a right,
the Identity PDA is the holder — making rights portable across wallets.
PDA: `["identity_rights", identity, parcel, rights_kind]`.
One IdentityRights per (identity, parcel, kind) is allowed.

fields.name: identity
docs: The Identity PDA that holds this right.

fields.name: parcel
docs: The parcel this right applies to.

fields.name: rights_kind
docs: Right kind (OWNERSHIP, USAGE, EASEMENT, etc.).

fields.name: granter
docs: Who granted this right (must be the current owner or granter).

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Unix timestamp; 0 means no expiration.

fields.name: status
docs: ACTIVE, EXPIRED, REVOKED.

types.name: Jurisdiction
docs: A registered jurisdiction (country/zone) in the cross-border identity system.
PDA seed: `["jurisdiction", country_code]`.

fields.name: country_code
docs: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 padded to 16 bytes (e.g. b"KE\x00..." for Kenya).

fields.name: authority
docs: The jurisdiction authority wallet (issues/revokes credentials).

fields.name: jurisdiction_name
docs: Human-readable name (max 64 chars).

fields.name: credential_schema_cid
docs: IPFS CID of the W3C Verifiable Credential schema.

fields.name: revocation_registry
docs: On-chain or oracle reference for revocation checks.

fields.name: verification_key_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the ZK verification key for this jurisdiction's circuit.

fields.name: algorithm_id
docs: 0 = Groth16, 1 = FRI-STARK.

fields.name: status
docs: 0 = Active, 1 = Suspended, 2 = Withdrawn.

types.name: JurisdictionBinding
docs: Binds a person (via identity_hash) to a jurisdiction with a ZK proof.
PDA seed: `["cross_border_identity", jurisdiction_key, identity_hash]`.

fields.name: identity_hash
docs: The identity_hash from the existing Identity account.

fields.name: jurisdiction_key
docs: The Jurisdiction PDA this binding belongs to.

fields.name: credential_commitment
docs: Pedersen commitment to the credential.

fields.name: nullifier
docs: Derived nullifier to prevent double-binding and proof reuse.

fields.name: proof_data
docs: The serialized ZK proof (max 512 bytes).

fields.name: proof_version
docs: Version of the proof circuit (for future upgrades).

fields.name: algorithm_id
docs: 0 = Groth16, 1 = FRI-STARK.

fields.name: revoked
docs: Whether this binding has been revoked.

fields.name: revoked_at
docs: Timestamp of revocation (0 if not revoked).

fields.name: revoked_by
docs: Who revoked this binding.

fields.name: bound_at
docs: When the binding was created.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Optional expiry (0 = no expiry).

fields.name: verified
docs: Whether a validator has attested this binding's proof off-chain.
Binding is a permissionless *claim*; only verified bindings should be
relied upon (circuit verification is deferred to audit; see RFC-006).

fields.name: verified_by
docs: Validator that last verified this binding.

fields.name: version
docs: Monotonic counter, bumped on re-verification.

fields.name: claim
docs: The claim this observation is about.

fields.name: validator
docs: Validator who made this observation.

fields.name: observed_at
docs: When the observation was made.

fields.name: location
docs: Location of observation (encoded as latitude/longitude i64 pair, or 0,0).

fields.name: method
docs: Method used for observation (e.g. 0=visual, 1=GPS, 2=survey, 3=document review).

fields.name: findings_hash
docs: Free-form findings hash (sha-256 of detailed findings document).

fields.name: confidence
docs: Confidence level (0-100).

fields.name: signature_hash
docs: sha-256 of the signed observation payload (for signature verification).

types.name: ObservationV2
docs: Multi-source observation of a task subject.
PDA: `["observation_v2", task_id, observer, nonce]`
Roles (Design Rule 7): `subject` ≠ `capture_device` ≠ `observer`
(submitter). A document owned by Alice (`subject`), photographed on
Bob's phone (`capture_device`), submitted by Charlie (`observer`).

fields.name: task_id
docs: Task this observation supports.

fields.name: observer
docs: Submitting wallet (PDA seed). May differ from `capture_device`.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Unique nonce per (task_id, observer). PDA seed.

fields.name: subject
docs: What is observed — claim, parcel, identity, or other account key.

fields.name: capture_device
docs: Device that captured the raw signal / image (may equal observer).

fields.name: source
docs: One of `observation_source`.

fields.name: provenance
docs: One of `observation_provenance`.

fields.name: location
docs: Lat/lon * 1e7; `[0,0]` = no location (document / remote).

fields.name: observed_at
docs: When the phenomenon was observed (device clock / capture time).

fields.name: findings_hash
docs: sha256 of findings / structured observation payload.

fields.name: evidence_hash
docs: sha256 of evidence pre-image (manifest root; Phase 5 expands).

fields.name: confidence
docs: Confidence 0–100.

fields.name: signature_hash
docs: sha256 of signed observation envelope (device or submitter signature).

types.name: Observer
docs: An on-chain observer (non-validator participant) who can submit
observations for claims.
PDA: `["observer", wallet]`

fields.name: wallet
docs: The observer's wallet pubkey.

fields.name: identity
docs: Optional linked identity (e.g. from terra_identity program).

fields.name: status
docs: Current status (ACTIVE, SUSPENDED).

fields.name: total_observations
docs: Total observations submitted.

fields.name: confirmed_observations
docs: Observations that were confirmed by quorum.

types.name: Parcel
docs: A parcel of land.
**DEPRECATED: `owner` field** — Ownership should be expressed through
`IdentityRights` with `rights_kind == OWNERSHIP` instead of the direct
`owner` wallet field. The `is_authorized_owner()` function supports both
paths. New code should prefer the IdentityRights path. The `owner` field
is retained for backward compatibility and will be removed in a future
major version once all existing accounts have migrated.

fields.name: owner
docs: **DEPRECATED**: Use `IdentityRights(OWNERSHIP)` instead.
Retained for backward compatibility. See `is_authorized_owner()`.

fields.name: rights_count
docs: Monotonic nonce for the parcel's Rights PDAs. Never decremented.

fields.name: access_hash
docs: sha-256 canonical digest over the off-chain infra/access validation
(parcel id, flags, reachability metrics). Tamper-evidence anchor.

types.name: QuorumConfig
docs: On-chain quorum configuration. Defines how many attestations and what
confidence level are required to verify a claim of a given type, in
a given region. Global defaults can be overridden per-type or per-region.
PDA: `["quorum_config", parcel_type, region]`

fields.name: parcel_type
docs: Parcel type this config applies to (0 = global default).

fields.name: region
docs: Region this config applies to ([0,0] = global default).

fields.name: required_attestations
docs: Number of attestations required.

fields.name: required_confidence
docs: Minimum confidence level (0-100) required from each attestation.

fields.name: set_by
docs: Who set this config.

types.name: QuorumTally
docs: Aggregated quorum tally for a claim.
PDA: `["quorum_tally", claim]`

fields.name: claim
docs: The claim this tally is for.

fields.name: total_weight
docs: Total weight of all votes.

fields.name: confirm_weight
docs: Weight of confirm votes.

fields.name: dispute_weight
docs: Weight of dispute votes.

fields.name: abstain_weight
docs: Weight of abstain votes.

fields.name: total_votes
docs: Total number of votes cast.

fields.name: quorum_threshold
docs: Required weight to pass quorum.

fields.name: resolved
docs: Whether quorum has been resolved.

types.name: QuorumVote
docs: A weighted vote cast by a validator on a claim.
PDA: `["quorum_vote", claim, voter]`

fields.name: claim
docs: The claim being voted on.

fields.name: voter
docs: The validator casting the vote.

fields.name: vote
docs: Vote choice (0=confirm, 1=dispute, 2=abstain).

fields.name: weight
docs: Reputation-based weight at time of vote (min(reputation_score, 10000)).

fields.name: stake_amount
docs: SOL staked at time of vote (if applicable, 0 otherwise).

types.name: ReputationSlashed
docs: Reputation slash (score hits 0). Distinct from staking `ValidatorSlashed`
so Anchor IDL event discriminators stay unique.

types.name: Rights
docs: A right attached to a parcel (ownership, usage, easement, ...).
PDA: `["rights", parcel, nonce]`. One or more Rights may exist per parcel;
`nonce` is allocated from `Parcel::rights_count` at grant time.

fields.name: holder
docs: Party holding the right.

fields.name: granter
docs: Party who granted the right (invariably the parcel owner).

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Unix timestamp; 0 means no expiration.

fields.name: status
docs: Time-bound credential status (RFC-009): ACTIVE, EXPIRING, EXPIRED, GRACE, RENEWED, REVOKED.

fields.name: grace_period_secs
docs: Grace period in seconds after expiry (0 = no grace). Set at grant time.

types.name: SlashingReport
docs: One record per slashing report.
PDA seed: `["slashing_report", stake_pool_key, reporter_key, evidence_hash]`.

fields.name: stake_pool
docs: StakePool key.

fields.name: reporter
docs: Wallet that filed the report.

fields.name: evidence_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the evidence payload.

fields.name: offender
docs: Validator accused of misbehavior.

fields.name: offense_type
docs: 0=equivocation, 1=liveness, 2=collusion.

fields.name: offense_details
docs: Bounded details (e.g., two conflicting parcel hashes).

fields.name: reporter_bond
docs: SOL bonded by reporter (for false-report penalty).

fields.name: status
docs: 0=Pending, 1=Verified, 2=Slashed, 3=Appealed, 4=Rejected, 5=Dismissed.

fields.name: filed_at
docs: When the report was filed.

fields.name: appeal_deadline
docs: filed_at + APPEAL_WINDOW_SECS.

fields.name: resolved_at
docs: When the report was resolved (0 if pending).

types.name: StakePool
docs: One stake pool per region, derived from the ValidatorRegistry key.
PDA seed: `["stake_pool", region_registry_key]`.

fields.name: region_registry
docs: ValidatorRegistry key for this region.

fields.name: total_staked
docs: Total SOL staked across all validators (lamports).

fields.name: reward_rate_bps
docs: Annual reward rate in basis points (e.g., 500 = 5%).

fields.name: accumulated_rewards
docs: Total rewards accrued but not yet distributed (lamports).

fields.name: reward_per_token_stored
docs: Global reward-per-token accumulator, scaled by REWARD_PRECISION (1e9).
When distribute_rewards fires: rpt += period_reward * PRECISION / total_staked.
Validators claim: (rpt - stake.rpt_paid) * staked_amount / PRECISION.

fields.name: last_reward_distribution
docs: Timestamp of last reward distribution.

fields.name: slash_count
docs: Total slashing events executed.

types.name: SubdivisionRecord
docs: One record per sub-parcel, linking it back to the original parcel.
PDA seed: `["subdivision", original_parcel, sub_parcel]`.

fields.name: original_parcel
docs: The parent parcel's PDA key.

fields.name: sub_parcel
docs: The child sub-parcel's PDA key.

fields.name: original_geometry_hash
docs: Parent's geometry hash at time of subdivision.

fields.name: new_geometry_hash
docs: Child's geometry hash.

fields.name: surveyor_attestation
docs: Attestation PDA that recorded surveyor sign-off.

fields.name: rights_migrated
docs: Whether rights have been migrated to the sub-parcel.

fields.name: attestations_migrated
docs: Whether attestations have been migrated.

fields.name: initiated_by
docs: Wallet that initiated the subdivision.

fields.name: completed_at
docs: When migration finished (0 if in progress).

fields.name: status
docs: 0=Pending, 1=Completed, 2=Failed.

types.name: TaskAssignment
docs: Selected validator for a task (requester assignment or self-claim).
PDA: `["task_assignment", task_id, validator]`

fields.name: validator
docs: Assigned validator wallet.

fields.name: requester
docs: Requester wallet that created the task (audit trail).

fields.name: assigned_by
docs: Who performed the assignment: requester = assign, validator = claim.

fields.name: status
docs: One of `assignment_status`.

fields.name: submitted_at
docs: 0 until `submit_task_result`.

types.name: TaskRequirement
docs: One row of eligibility / evidence constraints for a task.
PDA: `["task_requirement", task_id, req_index]`

fields.name: req_index
docs: Append-only index (0, 1, … requirement_count-1).

fields.name: capability_code
docs: Required capability (`capability_code`) or `CAPABILITY_ANY`.

fields.name: min_reputation
docs: Minimum legacy `ValidatorReputation.reputation_score` (0 = none).

fields.name: min_tier
docs: Minimum `ValidatorProfile.tier` (0 = any).

fields.name: jurisdiction
docs: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 as two bytes; `[0,0]` = any jurisdiction.

fields.name: radius_m
docs: Max distance from center in meters; 0 = no geographic constraint.

fields.name: center_lat_e7
docs: Geographic center (degrees * 1e7) when `radius_m > 0`.

fields.name: independence_bps
docs: Preferred independence (relationship-graph) threshold in bps (0 = none).

fields.name: confidence_target_bps
docs: Minimum confidence the result should target (0–10000 bps).

fields.name: registry
docs: The ValidatorRegistry this tracker belongs to.

fields.name: validator
docs: The validator whose activity is tracked.

fields.name: last_active
docs: Unix timestamp of last recorded activity (heartbeat or signed tx).

fields.name: is_active
docs: Soft flag — set to false by admin to forcibly exclude a validator from
quorum without removing them from the registry.

types.name: ValidatorAvailability
docs: Current availability state (distinct from reputation jail).
PDA: `["validator_availability", wallet]`

fields.name: status
docs: One of `availability_status`.

types.name: ValidatorCapability
docs: Declared/verified capability for one capability code.
PDA: `["validator_capability", wallet, capability_code]`

fields.name: capability_code
docs: Capability code (`capability_code`).

fields.name: level
docs: Confidence level (`capability_level`).

fields.name: evidence_hash
docs: Optional evidence hash backing a VERIFIED/TRUSTED claim (0 = none).

fields.name: verified_at
docs: 0 until verified; set when level reaches VERIFIED or above.

fields.name: registry
docs: The registry this endorsement applies to.

fields.name: proposed
docs: The validator pubkey being proposed (target of the action).

fields.name: action
docs: P0-2: governance action this endorsement authorizes (ADD or REMOVE).

fields.name: endorsers
docs: Validators who endorsed this proposal.

fields.name: required
docs: Required endorsements to approve.

fields.name: registry
docs: The registry this nomination applies to.

fields.name: country_code
docs: Country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).

fields.name: sponsor
docs: Existing validator who nominated the candidate.

fields.name: candidate
docs: Wallet being nominated for validator status.

fields.name: documents_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the candidate's identity documents.

fields.name: location_hash
docs: SHA-256 of a witness location report (never raw GPS).

fields.name: assigned_physical_confirmer
docs: Randomly selected physical confirmer (set at nomination time via
deterministic seed, NOT sponsor's choice).

fields.name: confirmers
docs: Validators who have confirmed (max NOMINATION_CONFIRMATIONS).

fields.name: finalized
docs: True once 3 confirmations are collected and candidate is added.

types.name: ValidatorPresence
docs: Dynamic geographic presence — timestamped, confidence-scored, expiring.
Never treat as immutable identity. PDA: `["validator_presence", wallet]`

fields.name: latitude_e7
docs: Latitude in degrees * 1e7 (i32) — compact fixed-point.

fields.name: longitude_e7
docs: Longitude in degrees * 1e7.

fields.name: accuracy_m
docs: Horizontal accuracy in meters.

fields.name: provenance
docs: How the fix was obtained (`presence_provenance`).

fields.name: confidence_bps
docs: Confidence in this presence fix (0–10000 bps).

fields.name: observed_at
docs: When this fix was recorded.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: After this time the presence is stale (observed_at + TTL).

types.name: ValidatorProfile
docs: Core validator profile — identity + tier attributes (not location-bound).
PDA: `["validator_profile", wallet]`

fields.name: wallet
docs: The validator's wallet (mobile participant — NOT a region).

fields.name: tier
docs: Trust tier (`profile_tier`). Starts NEW; admin/governance promotes.

fields.name: identity_hash
docs: Optional link to an off-chain/on-chain identity hash (0 = unset).

fields.name: note
docs: Free-form operator note (device class, org, …) — not used for selection.

fields.name: admin
docs: Bootstrap admin who can add validators unilaterally in bootstrap mode.

fields.name: validators
docs: Current list of registered validators.

fields.name: required_endorsements
docs: Minimum endorsements needed for new additions in peer-consensus mode.
Recomputed on every validator count change; not read from storage for
authorization decisions.

fields.name: paused
docs: Emergency pause flag. When true, all pausable subsystem instructions
(staking, cross-border, guardian, zk, escrow, dispute) reject
state-changing calls. Core parcel/identity operations authorized by
individual owners are unaffected — the admin stops processing via
off-chain policy.

fields.name: version
docs: Monotonic counter bumped on each change.

types.name: ValidatorRelationshipEdge
docs: Directed relationship graph edge (endorsement / co-validation / infra).
Correlation ≠ fraud — used for review, not auto-punishment (RFC-012 §6.12).
PDA: `["validator_edge", from, to, edge_type]`

fields.name: edge_type
docs: One of `relationship_edge_type`.

fields.name: weight_bps
docs: Optional strength (0–10000 bps); default 10000 for binary endorsement.

types.name: ValidatorReputation
docs: Tracks an individual validator's reputation and performance metrics.
PDA: `["validator_reputation", validator]`

fields.name: validator
docs: The validator's pubkey.

fields.name: status
docs: Current status (ACTIVE, JAILED, SLASHED).

fields.name: total_attestations
docs: Total attestations submitted.

fields.name: confirmed_attestations
docs: Attestations that were confirmed by quorum.

fields.name: disputed_attestations
docs: Attestations that were disputed/challenged.

fields.name: reputation_score
docs: Reputation score in basis points (0 = slashed, 10000 = perfect).

fields.name: jailed_until
docs: Timestamp when the validator was jailed (0 if not jailed).

fields.name: challenges_received
docs: Total number of successful challenges against this validator.

fields.name: challenges_raised
docs: Total number of challenges raised by this validator.

types.name: ValidatorStake
docs: One record per validator per region.
PDA seed: `["validator_stake", stake_pool_key, validator_key]`.

fields.name: stake_pool
docs: StakePool key.

fields.name: validator
docs: Validator's Ed25519 pubkey.

fields.name: staked_amount
docs: Current stake in lamports.

fields.name: unbonding_amount
docs: Amount in unbonding period.

fields.name: unbonding_starts_at
docs: When unbonding began (0 if not unbonding).

fields.name: reward_per_token_paid
docs: Snapshot of the pool's reward_per_token_stored at the time of last
claim or deposit. Claimable = (pool.rpt - self.rpt_paid) * staked / PRECISION.

fields.name: rewards_accrued
docs: Rewards accumulated but not yet claimed (legacy field, kept for compat).

fields.name: slash_history
docs: Number of past slashing events (for graduated severity).

fields.name: offenses
docs: Recent offense flags: [equivocation, liveness, collusion, unused].

fields.name: claim
docs: The claim being attested.

fields.name: validator
docs: Validator submitting this attestation.

fields.name: observation
docs: The observation this attestation is based on.

fields.name: result
docs: Attestation result (confirmed, disputed, unable_to_verify).

fields.name: confidence
docs: Confidence level (0-100).

fields.name: signature_hash
docs: sha-256 of the signed attestation payload.

fields.name: protocol_version
docs: Protocol version for audit trail.

types.name: VerificationSession
docs: A stateful session that tracks a claim through its full verification
lifecycle. Links evidence, observations, and attestations. Manages
timeout and quorum progression.
PDA: `["verification_session", claim, session_id]`

fields.name: claim
docs: The claim being verified.

fields.name: session_id
docs: Unique session identifier (caller-provided).

fields.name: status
docs: Current session status.

fields.name: opened_by
docs: Participant who opened the session.

fields.name: evidence_count
docs: Number of evidence items attached.

fields.name: observation_count
docs: Number of observations submitted.

fields.name: attestation_count
docs: Number of confirmatory attestations.

fields.name: dispute_count
docs: Number of disconfirmatory attestations.

fields.name: required_attestations
docs: Required attestations for quorum.

types.name: VerificationTask
docs: First-class work unit (requester, subject, class, reward, deadline).
PDA: `["task", task_id]`

fields.name: task_id
docs: Client-provided unique id (e.g. SHA-256 of the task statement).

fields.name: requester
docs: Who created and funds the task (pays rent; Phase 8 escrow source).

fields.name: subject
docs: What the task is about — claim, parcel, identity, or other account.
Not constrained to one program (migration map: claims become subjects).

fields.name: task_class
docs: One of `task_class`.

fields.name: status
docs: One of `task_status`.

fields.name: reward_lamports
docs: Reward in lamports recorded for Phase 8 distribution (0 = unfunded).

fields.name: deadline
docs: Unix ts after which the task cannot be claimed/assigned/submitted.

fields.name: description_hash
docs: sha256 of off-chain task description / requirements narrative.

fields.name: requirement_count
docs: Number of `TaskRequirement` rows (append-only via req_index).

fields.name: assigned_count
docs: Number of `TaskAssignment` rows created.

fields.name: required_validators
docs: How many submitted results are needed to complete (1..=MAX_TASK_VALIDATORS).

fields.name: result_count
docs: How many results have been submitted so far.

fields.name: outcome
docs: One of `task_outcome` (PENDING until first result).

fields.name: result_hash
docs: Canonical hash of the aggregated result / report.

fields.name: completed_at
docs: 0 until COMPLETED.

fields.name: admin
docs: Global founder — temporary sole authority during bootstrap phase.

fields.name: allocations
docs: Country allocations: which admin is approved to create a registry
for which country code.
